Mike H: heads up — noticed growing mem in kv cache on long-context sims, fragmentation looks correlated with shard cross-refs :confused:
Sophia L: can you paste the profiler slice?
Mike H: quick one, attached heatmap earlier but here's a small sample from a run where we fed many long prompts: 
```
kv.allocs: total=12.4GB live=9.1GB fragments=1.8GB
bucket-16B: in-use=430k, free-chunks=12k
bucket-256B: in-use=48k, free-chunks=3k
bucket-4k: in-use=1.2k, free-chunks=90
slots/stub: high reuse but many holes per shard
```
Alice K: hmm this smells like entanglement between small-block bins and shard-local reuse. allocator keeps tiny fragments that can't be coalesced because adjacent slots belong to different shards.
Ryan P: reproduced locally with fuzzer — longcontext + interleaved shards triggers a steady increase in retained fragments even after eviction.
Sophia L: did we try liberate-on-evict (the flag that forces coalesce across shards)?
Mike H: yep, tried --kv-libcoalesce=1, helped a bit but CPU went up 15% and latency jitter spiked. Not acceptable for SLO.
Alice K: proposal: instead of global coalesce, we do a heuristic "unwind" that promotes contiguous free ranges when shard ownership probability > 0.7, and otherwise mark as candidate for deferred compact. That reduces locking and spreads compaction cost.
Ryan P: sounds good. How to score candidates? age + fragmentation density?
Alice K: score = free_runs * avg_run_size / (1 + owner_entropy). Owner_entropy = shard entropy over run. Lower entropy => easier to coalesce safely.
Sophia L: can we piggyback on existing eviction path so we don't add another GC pass? e.g., when a token finishes and causes eviction, try lightweight coalesce on nearby ranges up to a budget.
Mike H: yes budgeted compaction is a requirement. If we do budget=1ms per eviction op, we keep tail latency predictable.
dev-bot: perf-alert: kv-cache-retained-growth > 7% over baseline on staging (run 2024-09-14T09:02Z)
Ryan P: staging alert matches our local repro. I'll push a small debug build with extra telemetry for run tonight.
Sophia L: can you add a histogram metric: "kv.run_owner_entropy" and "kv.coalesce_time_ms"? want to correlate.
Ryan P: will do. Also adding a feature flag `kv.unwind_heuristic=v1` to gate experiments.
Alice K: another tuning: increase blocksize mixing for high long-context workloads — move the balance between 256B and 4k bins to reduce small slack. But risk: increases internal waste for short contexts. Need per-workload profile.
Mike H: right — maybe auto-tune per-customer: if median seq_len > 1k, bias to larger block sizes. Redwood Optimize could suggest this.
Sophia L: good call. For immediate rollout: 1) enable unwind_heuristic in staging 2) budget compaction to 1ms/evict 3) collect entropy + coalesce metrics 4) run long-context replay overnight
Mike H: I'll own the rollout. Ryan, ping when debug build is up.
Ryan P: pushed build to staging with kv.unwind_heuristic=v1 and telemetry. tag me if you see regressions.
Alice K: I'll sketch the PR for the scoring function and a small unit test that stresses shard boundary coalesces.
Mike H: thanks. low-risk plan. if unwinding doesn't help we'll try a background compactor with IO-friendly backoff.
Sophia L: also add an alert: kv.coalesce_time_ms_p95 > 5ms so we catch regressions fast.
Mike H: agreed. thanks all :thumbsup:
dev-bot: deploy: staging -> kvcache-experiments deployed by Ryan P at 2024-09-14T11:45Z :rocket:
